About.history: Anan Real Estate Company started in 2020 as a company specialized in providing advisory services for nearly five years. During this period, the company achieved accomplishments and successes that made it one of the leading companies in this field and captured a large market share; the driving force was and still is to provide the best service to its clients through a highly competent and experienced team.

Services.title: Our Products
Services.subtitle: Choose the solution that suits your needs from real estate brokerage solutions

propertyPurchase.title: Property Purchase
propertyPurchase.description: Highest real estate financing to purchase property (completed or incomplete) with the lowest profit margin and down payment savings throughout the Kingdom

propertyMortgage.title: Property Mortgage
propertyMortgage.description: Get liquidity secured by property to purchase another property, renovate and renew property, or release property mortgage and refinance to complete building your property or purchase another property with affordable monthly installments

landAndLoan.title: Land and Loan
landAndLoan.description: Choose the land you want without being restricted to any plans, we provide you with the necessary financing to purchase it and the necessary financing to build your home in the way that suits you

completionConstruction.description: Get the necessary liquidity to build your land or complete building an incomplete property

selfConstruction.title: Self-Construction
selfConstruction.description: We provide you with the necessary financing to build your dream home by mortgaging the land or incomplete property in the form of payments according to construction stages or as a single payment

commercialFinancing.title: Commercial Financing
commercialFinancing.description: If you are a business owner and want to expand your business, we provide you with a commercial loan, requiring the presence of points of sale, financial statements, and account statement for one year
